title: Test the measuring instrument before judging the contestant.
evidence_kind: Retained historical game-observation and trial-result records; no new game run for this case study.

re_evaluation.target_rule: Each measured window must meet both frozen delivery targets.

relationship.instrument_difference: The save-building adapter and agent-tool implementation changed; the recorded evaluator identity changed.
relationship.interpretation: Same design and targets, rebuilt under a repaired instrument. This is not an identical-binary or identical-protocol performance comparison.

important_limits: A failed positive control prevented a contestant verdict; its missing measurements are null, not zero.
Disconnected control delivery of zero is the expected result, even though the delivery-target scorer labels that control FAIL.
The failed contestant produced both outputs. Failure means it missed the minimum in at least one required window, not that the factory never worked.
Recorded rates and outcomes are historical; current campaign, model and deployed-service readiness were not assessed or rerun.
This case is not a model ranking, a broad factory-design success claim or an earned-progression result.
The diagrams and tables are authored explanations. No game saves, screenshots, map tiles, game asset tables, application source or private operational details are included.
Control windows lasted 61 game seconds; contestant windows lasted 121, 122 and 121 game seconds. They are different checks, not matched performance runs.
